limitations: The two scoped groups partition current declared decorative shadows and retain declared selection indicators. Full removal also changes selection and any other computed shadows; it is a positive intervention control, not an exact scoped-group union. A group comparison does not isolate individual selectors or shader implementations.
Single fresh jobs match source/runtime/ISA/actual controller binaries and original workload operations, without establishing identical physical hardware or repeat reliability.
A fixed owned document insertion retains every original source byte/security header and all original app script/style/API responses, but remains a distinct diagnostic workload.
Marker order and frame callbacks do not measure actual OS paint; whole-job CPU does not isolate an application function. No control cost is subtracted from release metrics.
Incomplete observations cannot support causal comparisons. Normal baseline success does not waive known full-application sustained failures.
Full installed/native, signing, managed deployment, eight-hour and previously held investigation requirements remain open. BSD public-source mapping is approved and completed.
